strongest_angle: Break down Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra's October 2026 guidelines from the Program on Negotiation on how to make concessions that build goodwill and reciprocity without losing value.

key_facts.fact: Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra published guidelines on October 14th, 2026, outlining four strategies for making concessions in negotiation.
key_facts.source_name: Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

key_facts.fact: Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra explains that concessions are often necessary in negotiation, but they frequently go unappreciated and unreciprocated.

Katie Shonk writing for the Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School noted on September 27th, 2021, that key business skills in negotiation include trading concessions effectively with counterparts.
